description.en: The chief of the hypocrites in Islam.

transliteration.ar-Latn-x-alalc: ʿAbdullāh b. Ubayy b. Mālik b. al-Ḥārith b. ʿUbayd al-Khuzrajī, Abū al-Hubbāb, famous as Ibn Salūl, Salūl being his paternal grandmother's name, from Khuzāʿa.

tr: Abdullâh b. Ebî b. Mâlik b. el-Hâris b. Ubeyd el-Huzrecî, Ebû el-Hubbâb, meşhûr İbn Selûl adıyla ve Selûl babasının annesinin adı, Huzâ'adan.
ar: عبد الله بن أبي من مالك بن الحارث ابن عبيد الخزرجي، أبو الحباب،المشهور ب ابن سلول ، وسلول جدته لأبيه، من خزاعة

derived_from.edition_or_version: Khayr al-Dīn al-Ziriklī, al-Aʿlām (Beirut: Dār al-ʿIlm li’l-Malāyīn, 8th ed. 2002), 8 vols.
